title: What this run gives you back

verdicts.title: Verdict for every record
verdicts.description: One row per record you gave us: its position in your file, the verdict, whether it was charged, and why. This is the evidence behind the bill — you can re-do our arithmetic on it.

receipt.title: Live Excel receipt (OUTPUT.xlsx)
receipt.description: A real workbook, not a picture of numbers: the totals are COUNTIFs over the per-record verdicts, so every figure derives from the rows above it. Change the amount you paid in the yellow cell and the whole receipt recalculates.
